name: Agent Orange and other herbicides
authority: 38 CFR 3.309(e), expanded by the PACT Act
summary: If you served in one of these locations during the qualifying window, VA presumes you were exposed to herbicide agents. You do not need to prove exposure or show a link between your service and the condition. You still need a current diagnosis.

qualifyingService.label: Republic of Vietnam
qualifyingService.note: Includes inland waterways and territorial waters within 12 nautical miles of shore.

qualifyingService.label: Thailand military bases
qualifyingService.note: Any US or Royal Thai base, regardless of where on the base you served or your job.

qualifyingService.label: Cambodia, Mimot or Krek in Kampong Cham Province
Johnston Atoll
qualifyingService.note: Includes service aboard a ship that called at Johnston Atoll.

conditions.name: Chloracne or other acneform disease consistent with chloracne
conditions.qualifier: Must be at least 10 percent disabling within one year of exposure.

conditions.name: Ischemic heart disease
conditions.qualifier: Does not include hypertension or peripheral manifestations of arteriosclerosis.

conditions.name: Early-onset peripheral neuropathy
conditions.qualifier: Must be at least 10 percent disabling within one year of exposure.

conditions.name: Porphyria cutanea tarda
conditions.qualifier: Must be at least 10 percent disabling within one year of exposure.

conditions.name: Respiratory cancers
conditions.qualifier: Cancer of the lung, bronchus, larynx, or trachea.

conditions.name: All chronic B-cell leukemias
conditions.qualifier: Includes hairy-cell leukemia and chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

conditions.name: Soft-tissue sarcoma
conditions.qualifier: Excludes osteosarcoma, chondrosarcoma, Kaposi's sarcoma, and mesothelioma.

sourceReferences.note: Diseases associated with exposure to certain herbicide agents.
Herbicide exposure requirements for the presumption to apply.
